newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel 1997 EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel 1997 EPS raised.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said that analyst Thomas P. Kurlak raised his 1997 earnings per share estimate for Intel Corp to $9.00 from $7.70, keeping the stock rated a near and long term buy.

"Management indicated they were sold out for the first quarter and if they were willing to take more orders they could probably book up the second quarter as well," Kurlak said in his report. "(This) should alleviate investor concerns about a sequential slowdown."
-- He said that Intel was no longer assuming flat Pentium sales for 1997 and expected a 10 percent increase.

-- He said that Merrill's $200 price objective looked realistic given the $9.00 per share earnings estimate and "given that 1998 is likely to be another up year without a recession, with Intel's earnings at $11.00 (per share) or more."
